title: Battery Draining Quickly
query_variations: My battery is dying very fast
Phone doesn't last half a day
Phone battery drains in few hours
Battery life has become very bad
My phone barely lasts half a day
Battery doesn't last through the day
Phone dies within a few hours
Why does my phone lose charge so quickly
My battery backup has become terrible
Phone doesn't last all day anymore
bro my battery is literally dying
Battery drains so fast after update
Phone barely survives half a day
Battery goes from 100 to 0 in no time
steps: Turn on Battery Saver mode.
Check battery usage to see which apps are consuming the most power.
Reduce screen brightness or enable Auto-brightness.
Turn off background activity for apps you don't frequently use.

title: Phone Charges Slowly
query_variations: My phone takes hours to charge
Why is my phone charging so slowly?
Takes forever to charge my phone
symptoms: phone takes hours to reach full charge
steps: Ensure you are using the original charger and cable.
Clean the charging port gently with a wooden toothpick.
Make sure Fast Charging is enabled in Battery settings.

title: Phone Overheats While Charging
query_variations: My phone gets really hot when plugged in
Device is too hot while charging
steps: Remove any thick phone cases while charging.
Avoid using the phone for heavy tasks (gaming, video calls) while it's plugged in.
Try a different wall outlet or charger.

title: Battery Percentage Stuck
symptoms: phone shuts off with battery remaining
steps: Restart your phone.
Recalibrate the battery by letting it drain to 0%, then charge it uninterrupted to 100%.
Update your phone's software to the latest version.

title: Battery Drains Overnight
steps: Turn off Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Mobile Data before going to sleep, or use Airplane mode.
Check for apps running in the background and restrict them.
Disable Always-On Display during the night.

title: Battery Swelling
query_variations: The back cover is popping off
steps: STOP USING and STOP CHARGING the phone immediately.
Do not press or puncture the swollen area.
Take the device to an authorized Samsung service center as soon as possible.

title: Screen Flickering
query_variations: The display is flickering on and off
Screen flickers when I change brightness
Phone screen blinks on and off
steps: Restart the phone.
Check if the issue happens in Safe Mode. If not, a downloaded app is causing it.
Turn off 'Adaptive brightness' to see if it stabilizes.
Ensure your device software is up to date.

title: Auto Brightness Not Working
query_variations: Screen doesn't get brighter in the sun
steps: Clean the top part of your screen where the ambient light sensor is located.
Toggle Adaptive Brightness off and back on.
Reset app preferences in Settings.

title: Touchscreen Unresponsive
query_variations: I can't tap anything on the screen
symptoms: screen does not respond to taps
steps: Force restart the phone by holding the Power and Volume Down buttons for 10 seconds.
Remove any screen protectors and test again.
Clean the screen with a dry, soft cloth.

title: Screen Burn-in / Ghost Image
query_variations: I can see ghost icons on my screen
Screen has burn in from TikTok
symptoms: faint outline of previous content on screen
steps: Reduce screen timeout so the display turns off sooner.
Lower the screen brightness to prevent further degradation.
If the burn-in is severe, hardware replacement at a service center may be required.

title: Always-On Display Not Working
query_variations: Clock doesn't show when screen is off
symptoms: clock not shown on locked screen
steps: Check if AOD is enabled in Settings > Lock screen.
Make sure Power Saving mode is turned off, as it disables AOD.
Check if AOD is scheduled to only show at certain times.

title: Screen Too Dim
query_variations: Screen is too dark even on max
I can't see the screen outdoors
symptoms: screen appears too dim even at max brightness
steps: Turn off 'Extra dim' in Settings or Quick Panel.
Disable Power Saving mode.
Ensure you don't have a privacy screen protector reducing visibility.

title: Blurry Photos
query_variations: My photos are coming out blurry
Pictures look fuzzy and out of focus
Pictures from my rear camera look fuzzy
symptoms: photos appear blurry or out of focus
steps: Clean the camera lens with a microfiber cloth.
Tap the screen on the object you want to focus on before shooting.
Ensure your hands are steady or use a tripod.

title: Camera App Crashing
query_variations: Camera force closes when I open it
steps: Go to Settings > Apps > Camera > Storage and clear Cache and Data.
Restart your phone.
Check for software updates.

title: Blurry Night Photos
query_variations: Pictures in the dark look bad
Low light photos are very noisy
symptoms: photos in low light are blurry or noisy
steps: Use Night Mode explicitly in the camera app.
Hold the phone extremely still, as night mode takes a few seconds to capture.
Clean the camera lens.

title: Camera Shutter Lag
query_variations: Camera takes a second to capture
symptoms: noticeable delay between pressing shutter and photo capture
steps: Turn off 'Scene optimizer' if it's taking too long to process.
Lower the camera resolution slightly.
Save photos to internal storage instead of a slow SD card.

title: Front Camera Quality Issues
symptoms: front camera produces poor quality photos
steps: Wipe the screen over the front camera lens.
Turn off beauty filters in the camera app.
Make sure there is adequate lighting.

title: Camera Shows Black Screen
query_variations: Camera is just a black screen
I can't see anything in the camera app
steps: Restart the device immediately.
Clear cache for the Camera app in Settings.
Check if another app (like a barcode scanner) is currently using the camera in the background.

title: Phone Feels Slow or Laggy
query_variations: My phone is lagging a lot
My phone has become very slow
steps: Restart your phone.
Close background apps that you aren't using.
Check if your device storage is almost full, and free up space if needed.
Run device care / optimizer.

title: Phone Keeps Freezing
steps: Perform a forced restart (hold Power and Volume Down for 10 seconds).
Check for and install software updates.
Boot into Safe Mode to see if a third-party app is causing the freezing.

title: Slowdown Due to Low Storage
query_variations: Phone is slow and storage is full
Getting low space warning and lagging
symptoms: phone slow due to low storage
steps: Delete old photos, videos, or unused apps.
Clear cache data for frequently used apps like social media.
Move large files to an SD card or cloud storage.

title: Phone Overheats During Gaming
query_variations: Phone gets super hot playing games
Device burns my hand during gaming
steps: Lower the graphics settings in the game.
Remove the phone case while playing.
Close other background apps before starting a heavy game.
Play in a cooler environment.

title: Apps Keep Crashing
query_variations: My games crash to home screen
steps: Update the crashing apps from the Google Play Store.
Clear the cache and data for the specific app causing issues.
Ensure Android System WebView is updated.
Restart your phone.

title: Phone Takes Long to Start
query_variations: Phone takes too long to start
Stuck on Samsung logo for a while
Boot up time is very slow
symptoms: stuck on Samsung logo during startup
steps: Ensure your storage isn't almost full.
Wipe the cache partition from the Android recovery menu.
If the issue persists, a factory reset might be needed (backup data first).

title: Apps Taking Long to Open
query_variations: Apps are taking forever to open
It takes ages for apps to start
My apps are opening really slow
Every app takes forever to load
symptoms: individual apps take a long time to launch
steps: Restart your phone to clear temporary memory.
Go to Settings > Apps and clear cache for slow apps.
Check if your device storage is almost full and free up space.
Update all apps from the Google Play Store.
Run Device Care to optimize performance.
notes: Added to cover app-specific slowness vs general lag
